label: Time
name: HOLD_TIME
tip: When the inverter is online, the Time is based on the set Time Zone. Please go to the Configuration/Station/Station Management/Edit page to set Time Zone and daylight saving time.

label: Firmware version

tip: Firmware/LCD version of the inverter.

label: Max. AC Input Power(kW)
name: HOLD_MAX_AC_INPUT_POWER
tip: The maximum amount of power to be imported from the grid. And battery charging power will be adjusted based on Load consumption and grid import limitation.

label: LCD Type

tip: Please restart the inverter after changing the LCD Type setting to take effect.

label: Grid Sell Back Power(kW)
name: HOLD_FEED_IN_GRID_POWER_PERCENT
tip: If Grid Sell Back function is enabled, you can adjust the power limitation to feed into the grid.

label: Set System Type
name: HOLD_SET_MASTER_OR_SLAVE
tip: Used when paralleling inverters. It can only be set in standby mode or fault state.

label: Set Composed Phase
name: HOLD_SET_COMPOSED_PHASE
tip: Used to set EPS phase if not set automatically. It can only be set in standby mode or fault.

label: Measurement
name: MODEL_BIT_MEASUREMENT
tip: Determines whether or not you are using CTs or a Smart Meter to measure AC input.

label: CT Sample Ratio
name: BIT_CT_SAMPLE_RATIO
tip: Sample Ratio of the CTs being used.

label: Meter Port Reuse
name: BIT_METER_PORT_REUSE_TYPE
tip: When the grid side detection method is CT, it takes effect. After setting it to 1, it will start communicating with the meter and consider the collected power as the power of the ACcouple

CT Power Offset(W)

label: AC Charge Power(kW)

label: Backup SOC(%)

label: Backup Volt(V)

label: AC Charge Based On
name: BIT_AC_CHARGE_TYPE
tip: According to time: Set a preferred time period to charge the battery.According to SOC/Voltage: Set AC to charge the battery when the SOC/ voltage drops to the set threshold.

label: AC Charge Battery Current(A)
name: HOLD_AC_CHARGE_BATTERY_CURRENT
tip: Set it according to battery requirement.

label: Battery Type
name: MODEL_BIT_BATTERY_TYPE
tip:
Choose the battery type and then select Lithium Brand (for closed-loop communications), 
or battery capacity for lead-acid/lithium batteries with no communications. 
Please note after setting the battery type, all other settings will reset to default.

label: Lithium Brand / No comms
name: MODEL_BIT_LITHIUM_TYPE
options: 30=30: Lithium no comms: 15 cells in series
31=31: Lithium no comms: 16 cells in series
tip: Brand of compatible Lithium Batteries being used.

label: Bat2 Lithium Brand / No comms
name: BIT_LITHIUM_TYPE_2
options: 30=30: Lithium no comms: 15 cells in series
31=31: Lithium no comms: 16 cells in series
tip: Brand of compatible Lithium Batteries being used.

label: Lead-acid Capacity(Ah)
name: _12K_HOLD_LEAD_CAPACITY
tip: The capacity of installed lead acid battery banks and inverter will enter float charge mode when the charge current is less than 0.01C .

label: Absorb Voltage(V)
name: HOLD_LEAD_ACID_CHARGE_VOLT_REF
tip: Sets the discharge limit for lead-acid batteries.

label: Float Voltage(V)
name: HOLD_FLOATING_VOLTAGE
tip: Refer to the battery manufacturer's spec sheet for proper value. The inverter will enter float charge mode when the charge current is less than 0.01C.The float charge voltage should be less than Absorb Voltage.

label: On Grid Discharge Derate Vbatt(V)
name: HOLD_VBAT_START_DERATING
tip: Reduce the battery output power when the voltage drops below it, which will decrease from this value to 'On grid cut off Volt +1V'. And this setting just applies to lead-acid batteries and on grid mode.If you do not want this limit, you can set 'derate Vbatt' to be consistent with 'On grid cut off V

label: Equalization Voltage(V)
name: HOLD_EQUALIZATION_VOLTAGE
tip:
1: When using Lead Acid battery, setting range: 90~700.
2: When using Lithium battery in lead acid mode, input 0.

label: Equalization Period(Days)
name: HOLD_EQUALIZATION_PERIOD
tip:
1: When using Lead Acid battery, setting range: 0~365.
2: When using Lithium battery in lead acid mode, input 0.

label: Equalization Time(Hours)
name: HOLD_EQUALIZATION_TIME
tip:
1: When using Lead Acid battery, setting range: 0~24.
When using Lithium battery in lead acid mode, input 0.

label: System Charge SOC Limit(%)
name: HOLD_SYSTEM_CHARGE_SOC_LIMIT
tip: The max. charge SOC limit for the entire system.

label: System Charge Volt Limit(V)
name: HOLD_SYSTEM_CHARGE_VOLT_LIMIT
tip: The max. charge Voltage limit for the entire system.

label: Charge Current Limit(Adc)
name: HOLD_LEAD_ACID_CHARGE_RATE
tip: The Max. Charge current limitation of the entire system.

label: Discharge Current Limit(Adc)
name: HOLD_LEAD_ACID_DISCHARGE_RATE
tip: Sets the discharge limit for lead-acid batteries.

label: Start Discharge P_import(W)
name: HOLD_P_TO_USER_START_DISCHG
tip: When set to 100, the battery will begin to discharge power to take the loads when the imported power from the grid is higher than 100W.

label: Off-Grid Cut-Off SOC(%)
name: HOLD_SOC_LOW_LIMIT_EPS_DISCHG
tip: SOC% at which the batteries will stop discharging in Off-Grid mode. It should be less than or equal to On-grid cutoff SOC.When volt reaches it, inverter will forced charge +3%.Restore discharge: Discharge will allowed after forced charge +5%.

label: On-Grid Cut-Off SOC(%)
name: HOLD_DISCHG_CUT_OFF_SOC_EOD
tip: SOC% at which the batteries will stop discharging with Grid Access. It should be greater than or equal to Off-grid cutoff SOC.

label: Off-Grid Cut-Off Volt(V)
name: HOLD_LEAD_ACID_DISCHARGE_CUT_OFF_VOLT
tip: Voltage at which the batteries will stop discharging in Off-Grid mode.When volt reaches it, inverter will forced charge +2V when grid available.Restore discharge: Discharge will allowed after forced charge +2V. But if volt is still below 48V after that, it needs to be above 48V to allow discharge.

label: On-Grid Cut-Off Volt(V)
name: HOLD_ON_GRID_EOD_VOLTAGE
tip: Voltage at which the batteries will stop discharging with Grid Access

label: Batt Charge Current Limit(Adc)
name: OFF_GRID_HOLD_MAX_GEN_CHG_BAT_CURR
tip: Determines the amount of current used for charging the batteries with the Generator.

label: Charge Start Volt(V)
name: OFF_GRID_HOLD_GEN_CHG_START_VOLT
tip: Start the generator through dry contacts when battery voltage below start Volt. Warming up the generator for 2 minutes before Gen relay close.

label: Charge End Volt(V)
name: OFF_GRID_HOLD_GEN_CHG_END_VOLT
tip: Stop the generator by the dry contact after battery Voltage is higher than end Volt and perform a cool-down time

label: Gen Rated Power(kW)
name: HOLD_MAX_GENERATOR_INPUT_POWER
tip: You can limit the battery charge power based on the detected inverter’s load consumption and Generator input power limitations.

label: Charge Start SOC(%)
name: OFF_GRID_HOLD_GEN_CHG_START_SOC
tip: Start the generator through dry contacts when battery SOC below start SOC. Warming up the generator for 2 minutes before Gen relay close.

label: Charge End SOC(%)
name: OFF_GRID_HOLD_GEN_CHG_END_SOC
tip: Stop the generator by the dry contact after battery SOC is higher than end SOC and perform a cool-down time

label: AC Couple Start SOC(%)
name: _12K_HOLD_AC_COUPLE_START_SOC
tip: In off grid mode, it enters charge mode after SOC below Start SOC. Please ensure that the connected on-grid PV inverter has Frequency Shifting function

label: AC Couple End SOC(%)
name: _12K_HOLD_AC_COUPLE_END_SOC
tip: In off grid mode, it exits AC couple after SOC reaches End SOC.Set to 101%, allowing the AC Couple bypass to take load after being fully charged

label: AC Couple Start Volt(V)
name: _12K_HOLD_AC_COUPLE_START_VOLT
tip: In off grid mode, it enters charge mode after Voltage below Satrt volt. Please ensure that the connected on-grid PV inverter has Frequency Shift function

label: AC Couple End Volt(V)
name: _12K_HOLD_AC_COUPLE_END_VOLT
tip: In off grid mode, it exits AC couple after battery voltage reaches End Volt .Set to 59.5V, allowing the AC Couple bypass to take load after being fully charged .

label: Start PV Power(kW)
name: _12K_HOLD_START_PV_POWER
tip: This is the minimum PV power limit to function with smart load output.

label: Smart Load Start SOC(%)
name: _12K_HOLD_SMART_LOAD_START_SOC
tip: Turn on when the battery is above the Start SOC.

label: Smart Load End SOC(%)
name: _12K_HOLD_SMART_LOAD_END_SOC
tip: Turn off when the battery is below End SOC

label: Smart Load Start Volt(V)
name: _12K_HOLD_SMART_LOAD_START_VOLT
tip: Turn on smart load when the battery is above the Start Volt.

label: Smart Load End Volt(V)
name: _12K_HOLD_SMART_LOAD_END_VOLT
tip: Turn off smart load when the battery is below End Volt

label: Grid Type
name: _12K_HOLD_GRID_TYPE
tip: Select the correct Grid type to function, such as split phase: 240/120 or 208/120V.

label: Normal / Standby
name: FUNC_SET_TO_STANDBY
tip: When set to Standby, it stop feed in, charge and discharge. If the grid is available, the Grid bypass relay will close and the grid will take the load normally.

label: Off-Grid Mode
name: FUNC_GREEN_EN
tip: It is for absolute zero-export, when there is an AC connection. When enabled, the battery discharges power to load first and  the grid will not assist in powering loads and the batteries will not charge from AC unless 'AC charge' is enabled.

label: Buzzer Enable
name: FUNC_BUZZER_EN
tip: Enable/disable the alarm buzzer.

label: Grid Loss Warning Clear
name: FUNC_RUN_WITHOUT_GRID_12K
tip: Enable for an absolute Off-Grid system. The 'No AC Connection' and 'AC V /F out of range' warnings will not occur when enabled.

label: Power Backup
name: FUNC_EPS_EN
tip: Allows for the use of the inverter as a backup system.

label: Seamless EPS switching
name: FUNC_SW_SEAMLESSLY_EN

label: No Batteries
name: FUNC_PV_GRID_OFF_EN
tip: Allows access to Off-Grid mode when there is no battery and solar is the only input available.

label: RSD
name: FUNC_RSD_DISABLE
tip: Enable or disable the rapid shut-down detection of the PV inputs.

label: PV Arc
name: FUNC_PV_ARC
tip: The inverter will detect when there is a PV input Arc Fault and protect the inverter from an Arc Fault.

label: PV Arc Fault Clear
name: FUNC_PV_ARC_FAULT_CLEAR
tip: Clear the records of PV Arc fault.

label: Grid Sell Back
name: FUNC_FEED_IN_GRID_EN
tip: Enable to export power back to the grid. Disable for no export to the grid.

label: Grid Sell Back
name: FUNC_TAKE_LOAD_TOGETHER
tip: Enable to export power back to the grid. Disable for no export to the grid.

label: Fast Zero Export
name: FUNC_RUN_WITHOUT_GRID
tip: Allows for Zero Export. Inverter will speed up the control to avoid export power, but the control speed for import will be slowed down.Should be selected as the opposite of the Grid Sell Back setting.

label: Parallel Setting Data Sync
name: FUNC_PARALLEL_DATA_SYNC_EN
tip: Syncs master inverter settings with all paralleled inverters.

label: Share Battery
name: FUNC_BAT_SHARED
tip: Allows for the sharing of battery banks between inverters.

label: CT Direction Reversed
name: FUNC_CT_DIRECTION_REVERSED
tip: Used to reverses the direction of the CTs incase they were installed incorrectly.

label: Battery Backup Mode
name: FUNC_BATTERY_BACKUP_CTRL
tip: Enable to set battery as 24/7 backup power.This mode prioritizes using PV power and then grid power to charge and take load. Use battery only when there is a grid power outage.

label: Grid Peak-Shaving
name: FUNC_GRID_PEAK_SHAVING
tip: Peak-Shaving is used to avoid peak demand charges from the grid. Peak shaving can be accomplished by halting Grid Charging at specific times,for example, during periods of peak demand (i.e., high grid rates), or when the batteries are near fully charged based on SOC and Voltage.

label: AC Charge Enable
name: FUNC_AC_CHARGE
tip: Allows for the use of Grid power to charge the batteries.

label: Sporadic Charge
name: FUNC_SPORADIC_CHARGE
tip: Once enabled it in AC charge mode, the AC charging power will sporadic between the set AC charge power and 2% of the rated charge power.

label: PV Charge Priority
name: FUNC_FORCED_CHG_EN
tip: Routes the majority of PV production to charge the batteries.

label: Forced Discharge Enable
name: FUNC_FORCED_DISCHG_EN
tip: Forcably discharges batteries to supply loads demand or export to grid when Grid Sell back is enabled.

label: Export PV Only
name: FUNC_PV_SELL_TO_GRID_EN
tip: Enable for only PV sell back

label: Batt Charge Control
name: FUNC_BAT_CHARGE_CONTROL
tip: When communicating in closed-loop, select charge control according to 'SOC'. When not communicating in closed-loop, select 'Voltage' to charge by voltage readings.

label: Charge Last
name: FUNC_CHARGE_LAST
tip: This function is applicable to cases where the PV panels are over-sized. Setting charging to minimum priority allows the system to charge batteries while feeding in at maximum power when stronger light is available, thereby maximizing the use of available solar energy

label: Batt Discharge Control
name: FUNC_BAT_DISCHARGE_CONTROL
tip: When communicating in closed-loop, select discharge control according to 'SOC'. When not communicating in closed-loop, select 'Voltage' to discharge by voltage readings.

label: Micro-Grid
name: FUNC_MICRO_GRID_EN
tip: Only set this when Generator is connected to the Inverter's Grid Terminal. With this setting enabled, the inverter will use AC power to charge the battery and will not export any  power.

label: AC Couple
name: FUNC_AC_COUPLING_FUNCTION
tip: Connect existing On-Grid PV inverter to the Gen port as an AC Couple system.In On-grid mode, please enable Grid Sell Back or Off-grid mode.In Off-grid mdoe, please make sure the PV inverter have enabled the Frequency Shifting function.

label: Smart Load
name: FUNC_SMART_LOAD_ENABLE
tip: Repurposes the GEN port as a Loads Port. The inverter will then provide power to this load according to the configured settings.Noted: If you enable the Smart Load function, it's forbidden to connect the generator or AC Couple system at the same time, otherwise the device will be damaged!

label: Grid Always On
name: FUNC_ON_GRID_ALWAYS_ON
tip: Enable for continuous power supply on the GEN port when the grid is on.
